authentication_notes: /sessions is the only public endpoint for authentication. All other endpoints require a valid session token obtained from createSession or registerCitizen followed by login flow.
Operations marked auth_required need an authenticated session during test setup.
dependencies: createSession is required before any authenticated operation.
registerCitizen creates citizen accounts but does not automatically log in; subsequent profile operations depend on prior login via createSession.
citizen verification flows (createCitizenVerificationCode, verifyCitizenEmail) require an active session and must be completed before accessing citizen-specific features.
admin endpoints (listOperatorsForAdmin, createMunicipalityUser) depend on authenticated admin sessions.
report lifecycle operations (assignReportOperator, updateReportStatus, etc.) depend on report creation via createReport.
chat and notification operations depend on prior report creation or session establishment.
POST /reports -> GET /chats/{reportId}: A report must exist before an operation can address reportId.
POST /reports -> POST /chats/{reportId}/read: A report must exist before an operation can address reportId.
POST /sessions -> GET /sessions/current: getCurrentSession requires an active session created by createSession.
DELETE /sessions/current -> GET /citizens: getCitizenProfile requires an authenticated session; deleteCurrentSession invalidates it.
POST /registration -> GET /citizens: getCitizenProfile requires a logged-in citizen account created via registerCitizen.
POST /citizens/verification-code -> POST /citizens/verify-email: verifyCitizenEmail requires a valid verification code generated by createCitizenVerificationCode.
POST /reports -> PUT /reports/{id}/status: updateReportStatus requires an existing report created by createReport.
POST /reports -> PUT /reports/{id}/operator: assignReportOperator requires an existing report created by createReport.
POST /reports -> GET /reports/assigned: listAssignedReports requires reports to exist and be assigned.
POST /reports/{id}/internal-comments -> GET /reports/{id}/internal-comments: listInternalComments requires an existing report with comments.
POST /reports/{id}/messages -> GET /reports/{id}/messages: listReportMessages requires an existing report with messages.
POST /chats/{reportId}/read -> GET /chats/unread/count: getUnreadMessagesCount reflects state after markChatAsRead operations.

risks: registerCitizen does not automatically create a session; clients must implement explicit login flow after registration.
Verification token expiry (getCitizenVerificationToken) is time-sensitive and may expire before verifyCitizenEmail is called.
Admin endpoints lack explicit role checks in documentation; 403 responses indicate implicit authorization enforcement.
Report assignment operations (assignReportOperator, autoAssignTechnicalOfficer) assume report exists but do not specify error handling for invalid IDs.
Chat and notification endpoints rely on session state that can be invalidated by deleteCurrentSession without explicit cleanup guidance.
